evals.prompt: Use @ws-spec-multi for a typical spec-multi task in this project.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-spec-multi and follows its skill contract.
assertions: Agent loads ws-spec-multi before acting
Follows skill steps and Done when criteria
Uses path tokens from tools.md instead of hardcoded consumer paths
Output is en-us and harness-neutral

evals.prompt: /spec-multi — edge case: missing or incomplete config.json
evals.expected_output: Agent stops or bootstraps via configure-project/setup, not silent guessing.
assertions: Recognizes ws-spec-multi trigger from slash or @ invocation
References ws-shared/config.json or configure-project when config missing
Does not invent project-specific metadata

evals.prompt: /spec-multi — duplicate queue row: transitioning an item to in_progress appends a second row for the same slug instead of updating the existing row
evals.expected_output: Agent updates the existing row in place keyed by specPath/slug, fails closed on a duplicate index or slug, and keeps the item count frozen at the Phase 2 selection length.
assertions: Transitions update the existing row keyed by specPath or slug instead of appending a new row
A write that would duplicate a row index or slug fails closed and surfaces the conflict rather than writing the file
The reported item count equals the Phase 2 selection length (totalItems) and stays constant while items ship
After close, the state table holds exactly one terminal row per selected spec with no phantom pending rows
Per-row updatedAt and run frontmatter updatedAt advance on each transition

evals.prompt: /spec-multi — a new run supersedes an older run that is still active on the same item, and a child worker closes while its parent row stays in_progress
evals.expected_output: Agent retires the superseded run (cancelled/superseded) with an advancing updatedAt, and propagates the child's terminal state to the parent row and parent updatedAt.
assertions: The superseding run writes the superseded run's terminal status (cancelled or superseded) with an advancing updatedAt
At most one active runner exists per lineage and at most one item is in_progress per slug after retirement
A child worker reaching a terminal state transitions its parent queue row in place instead of leaving it in_progress
The parent run frontmatter updatedAt advances on the child handoff (never frozen beside a terminal child)
Re-applying a close or ship transition adds no rows and does not regress a terminal item status

evals.prompt: /spec-multi — a child worker merges while {plansDir}/{slug}/ holds no state file and no step-01 plan artifact
evals.expected_output: Agent fails closed before recording shipped via verify_child_artifacts.cjs, and never claims delivery evidence for the item.
assertions: The dispatch contract states the required child artifact set and the {child-workflow-id} state path under {plansDir}/{slug}/

Before recording shipped, the orchestrator runs the executable record_child_outcome.cjs (which invokes verify_child_artifacts.cjs) and a non-zero exit blocks the shipped row (mirroring missing-artifact)
The child step-01 artifact uses its contract name step-01-{slug}.plan.md, never an ad-hoc plan.md
The Phase 6 report claims delivery evidence only for items whose child state (and step-08-*.result.md for completed children) exists
